about: SHA-256 of the PUBLIC V3 render (no preview option) of the reference designs. Generated from b04f15e core.js; allRenderedVariants (which uses the default palette) re-generated on 2026-10-21 for the owner-approved QRAIVY neutral black / gray default palette (only the :root colour tokens changed, verified). Must not change otherwise. localBusiness and allRenderedVariants re-generated on 2026-10-23 for the owner-authorised Social Media contrast fix (only the .v3-social rule gained color:var(--v3-text), verified). Re-generated again on 2026-10-23 for the owner-requested Contact Brand-background icon fix (one added rule, .v3-bg-brand .v3-ct-row .v3-ic, verified). Re-generated on 2026-10-23 for the owner-approved Opening Hours Dark/Brand contrast rules (three added rules, verified). Re-generated on 2026-10-24 for the owner-decided Text Plain layout (text only): allRenderedVariants changes only by the removed image of its Plain Text section (verified). Restructured on 2026-10-29 for the owner-approved Phase C one-Hero-per-page rule: allRenderedVariants (three Heroes) split into allRenderedVariants (overlay Hero), allRenderedVariantsHeroSplit and allRenderedVariantsHeroSimple (one Hero each, plus the menu target s_hours1); renderer unchanged, every section byte-identical to the previous page (verified). Re-generated on 2026-11-08 for the owner-approved light-theme readability fixes (audit Problems 4-6): one added Contact rule on Dark, the Hero guard CSS, the guard element on overlay Heroes below 50 % darkening and the readable label colour on a custom Hero button colour (verified).

revisions.reason: default palette: brown/sepia -> QRAIVY neutral black / gray (Admin #101012, landing #f8f8f8 / #0a0a0a / #555; owner request, no navy); localBusiness (own palette) unchanged

Social Media contrast fix (owner-authorised after the 2A-3C visual review): .v3-social gained color:var(--v3-text) so the pill text no longer inherits white from Dark / Brand sections; the rendered pages differ from the previous version only in that one CSS rule (verified)

Contact icons on Brand sections (owner request after the 2A-3D visual review): added .v3-bg-brand .v3-ct-row .v3-ic{color:var(--v3-on-brand)} so the location / phone / email icons are white instead of orange on orange; the rendered pages differ from the previous version only by that one rule (verified)

Opening Hours on Dark / Brand sections (owner principle: readable foreground on any background, 2A-3E): Closed rows and the note inherit the section colour (opacity .85 on Dark), divider lines light on Dark; the rendered pages differ from the previous version only by those rules (verified)

Text section Plain layout is text only (owner decision before 2A-3G): a stored image is no longer rendered in Plain; the rendered page differs from the previous version only by that one removed <figure> (verified); localBusiness unchanged

Phase C section limits (owner-approved Option A): a page may hold at most one Hero, so the three-Hero fixture is split into one-Hero pages. Before the change the pre-Phase-C core.js (50393fd) reproduced all four previous entries exactly; the new entries were generated with that unchanged renderer, the Phase C core.js renders them identically, and the head, header, footer and all 16 rendered sections are byte-identical to the previous allRenderedVariants page in both contexts (verified); localBusiness entries unchanged

Hero mobile spacing and badge (owner-approved after the Studio V3 staging visual review): .v3-eyebrow font-size 11px -> 12px; split Hero on phones .v3-hero-media{margin-top:20px} (20px between the buttons and the stacked image), reset to margin-top:0 from 768px (side-by-side grid unchanged). Before the change the committed core.js (14b0fb6) reproduced every previous entry exactly; each new render equals that render with exactly these three CSS edits and nothing else (verified)

Social Media icons (owner-approved, narrowly scoped core.js change): each social chip shows the platform's fixed SVG mark (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, WhatsApp from controllers/lpController.js; current X and Pinterest marks) instead of its initial, in the page text colour; .v3-social-mark gained display:inline-flex and .v3-social-ic sizes the mark (20px). The rendered pages differ from the previous version only in those chips and that rule (verified); links, labels and order unchanged

Social Media icon size (owner-approved 24/48, CSS only): .v3-social-ic 20px -> 24px; .v3-social min-height/min-width 44px -> 48px (padding unchanged, 12+24+12 = 48px circle). Verified: output differs from 9316c65 only by these values.

T0 hero spacing (owner-approved): a Hero with style.spacing "compact" gets class v3-hero-compact and its CSS (phones 96 -> 52 px above the text, tablet+ 152 -> 88 px); added only to such pages. Verified: every other design byte-identical to 5efd4b9; the compact one differs only by the class and the CSS.

Light-theme readability (owner-approved audit, Problems 4-6): added .v3-bg-dark .v3-ct-row .v3-ic{color:inherit} (Contact icons on Dark take the section text colour; Brand unchanged); added the .v3-hero-guard CSS (a soft local shade behind Hero text over a photo); an overlay Hero with a photo and darkening below 50 % gets <div class="v3-hero-guard" style="opacity:g"> with 1-(1-o)(1-g)=0.5 (allRenderedVariants: 30 % -> 0.29); a custom Hero button colour also sets a readable label colour (core.js hintOnBrand with the chosen colour; allRenderedVariants: #ffffff). Before the change the committed core.js (2320b35) reproduced every previous entry exactly; each new render equals that render with exactly these additions and nothing else (verified)
